# dns_dname_record_set (Data Source)

Use this data source to get DNAME record set of the host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dns_dname_record_set" "example" {
  host = "example.com."
}

output "target" {
  value = data.dns_dname_record_set.example.target
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always set to the host.
- `target` (String) The DNAME target (alias) for the host.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL of the record.
